svg.text: STM32F407VGTx (100-pin LQFP) | TJA1051 (SO8) | ESP32 DevKit V1 (38-pin)
PB8 CAN1_RX from TJA1051 RXD pin4
PB9 CAN1_TX to TJA1051 TXD pin1
BOOT0 p94 to GPIO4 10k pull-down to GND on STM32 side
NRST p14 to GPIO5 via 100 ohm resistor
CAN bus: TJA1051 CANH/CANL to OBD-II
NRST: GPIO5 to STM32 p14 via 100 ohm
BOOT1/PB2 tied to GND. No 120 ohm on CAN bus.
10k pull-down on BOOT0 to GND for normal boot.
